headings: A more intense interpretation of Hypnotic Vanilla, featuring a higher concentration for a longer-lasting, deeply enveloping, and creamy amber gourmand scent.

jsonld_raw.name: HYPNOTIC VANILLA ELIXIR 80 ML (2.72 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description:
HYPNOTIC VANILLA ELIXIR 80 ML (2.72 FL. OZ.). A more intense interpretation of Hypnotic Vanilla, with a higher perfume concentration that prolongs its trail and enhances its character. Apricot blossom illuminates the composition, Sambac jasmine adds floral depth, and Surabsolute vanilla melts into a warm, creamy base that leaves a silky and deeply enveloping trail.

Amber gourmand | Intense, creamy, and enveloping.
